title: places describe result record (v1)
description: One requested POI id of a places describe invocation as one JSONL result record, at its original zero-based input position: present true with the AI-generated description text the returned entry carried, or present false as the placeholder of a missing or expired id. A duplicate input id renders again at each of its positions. An absent description is omitted, never emitted as null.

position.$comment: The original zero-based position of the id in the invocation's input order.

id.$comment: The opaque, ephemeral upstream POI id exactly as the caller supplied it; never validated for internal format.

present.$comment: Whether the chunk's response carried an entry matching this position's id.

description.$comment: The AI-generated description text the entry carried.
